title_sq: Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 prane hotel Roland te Unaza e Re 156,000 €
description_sq: Te unaza e re, prane hotel Rolandit, shesim nje apartament qe ndodhet ne objektin e quajtur Mesaplik. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i perfunduar, dhe eshte i gatshem per banim. Apartamenti ka sip totale prej 129.8 m2, nga te cilat siperfaqja e brendshme e aparatamentit eshte 109.1 m2. Apartamenti ka ne perberje 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete ku njera ka ndricim dhe ajrosje natyrale, salloni i pritjes si dhe 2 ballkone. Te gjitha ambientet e apartamentit kane akses ne ballkone duke mundesuar ajrosjen e te gjithe apartamentit.
title_en: Apartment 2+1+2 for sale near the Roland hotel in the New Ring, €156,000
description_en: In the new ring road, near the Roland hotel, we sell an apartment located in the building called Mesaplik. The apartment is completely finished, and is ready for living. The apartment has a total area of ​​129.8 m2, of which the internal surface of the apartment is 109.1 m2. The apartment consists of 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, one of which has natural lighting and ventilation, a living room and 2 balconies. All the premises of the apartment have access to the balcony, enabling the ventilation of the whole apartment.
